review_description: They were the first company to respond with a quotation.  They have provided lots of information and help.  David in particular is very helpful and has his own solar system installed.  He was courteous, knowledgable, helpful most of all prompt.

So far, we've only ordered the system and paid a deposit, it's not been installed yet. Everything these guys have done has been a level above the other companies we've been talking to. Why not a 5? Well... there's always room for improvement! :-)
Was the only company to follow up when the rebate changed and thus making the quote cheaper than original.
i paid my deposit, but have not heard back from Tom yet, he said have to wait from ETSA will take up to 6 weeks, now im still waiting.
